summary: Rulings Q1, Q2 and A1 applied and citations re-grounded on today's origin/main. ModernAppTemplate joins as P5, a root-template release that ZigbeeControl (P6, D1's proof), DHCPApp, ElectronicsInventory and IoTSupport take with copier update. The scaffold phase is dropped because ModernAppFrontendTemplate lost its validation pipeline in 032f366. P1–P9 push after their own gate. verification.json gains V13 for Q1. Committed as AnsibleSpecs bdc6def; the dry-run parses, and P4–P9's Targets resolve only after the environment restart (close-out A1).
